uncited: This method describes the binary parsing and deserialization of the OpenVDB (VDB) file format to reconstruct the hierarchical sparse voxel grid in memory.
It solves the problem of converting the compact, compressed on-disk representation into a traversable in-memory tree structure suitable for rendering or simulation.

It is distinguished from generic VDB loading by its explicit handling of the specific binary layout of Node5 and Node4 hierarchies, including the complex logic for decompressing active masks and inactive values, as opposed to using high-level library abstractions which may hide these details.
*   **Output**: An in-memory representation of the grid, typically structured as a `GridDescriptor` containing a `RootNode` (or `Tree`), which holds the sparse voxel data.
